model_route: Flowable-AE v2 primary route with reserved decision profile
validation_scope: Second-platform minimum calibration validation on a static mixed Flowable dataset; this is not a full AFL++ mutation fuzzing chain.
description: Flowable second-platform profile. It preserves the accepted Flowable-AE v2@6.3 final route and reserves the dynamic decision structure without enabling the second stage.
result_description: Runner reports summary_dur20.csv, summary_dur60.csv, body_valid_stats_dur20.json and body_valid_stats_dur60.json when Flowable REST and score service are available.
notes: Current Flowable final profile: Flowable-AE v2@6.3. v3 is retained only as a reference because it did not outperform v2. Do not describe this profile as a complete second-platform AFL++ fuzzing main chain.
runtime_requirements: Flowable REST should be available at FLOWABLE_BASE, defaulting to http://127.0.0.1:8080 in the runner template.
The AE score service should be started with the Flowable-AE v2 model and meta.
The local scripts/run_runner_flowable_plan.sh path must be available.
